title: 台词配音
anchor_text: Today I got up early, walked to the market and bought fresh bread for breakfast.

冷漠.instruction: flat and emotionless, low, quiet and slow, clipped words, no warmth at all

委屈.instruction: on the verge of tears, voice breaking and shaky, soft, slow with small pauses, sniffling

惊慌.instruction: panicked and shouting, out of breath, very fast, high pitch, stumbling over words

冷笑.instruction: starts with a short scoffing laugh, mocking and sarcastic, sharp, rising pitch on the question

尖刻.instruction: sneering and contemptuous, high and nasal, sharp biting words, looking down on someone

霸气.instruction: cold and commanding, low pitch, slow, every word firm and heavy, no hesitation

后悔.instruction: begging, voice trembling and cracking, close to crying, soft and slow

暧昧.instruction: intimate and sultry, low and breathy, slow, lingering on the vowels, a soft smile in the voice

耳语.instruction: an intimate breathy whisper right at the ear, very soft and slow, more air than voice

lines.text: The last train had already left, so we walked home along the river, talking about nothing at all.
lines.gloss: 末班车已经开走了，我们就沿着河走回家，一路闲聊。
